The '''2011–12 Eredivisie''' is the 56th season of [[Eredivisie]] since its establishment in 1955. It began in August 2011 with the first matches of the season <ref name="Season start">{{cite news|url=https://www.uefa.com/news/01f4-0ea29421eceb-9d00842d5979-1000--ajax-braced-to-hold-off-title-hopefuls/ |title=Ajax braced to hold off title hopefuls by Berend Scholten on UEFA.com |date=4 August 2011|access-date=4 August 2011|work=[[UEFA]] }}</ref> and ended in June with the last matches of the [[Europe]]an competition and relegation playoffs. [[AFC Ajax]] had the highest average attendance, around 49,000.

==Teams==
A total of 18 teams are taking part in the league, the best 15 teams from the [[2010–11 Eredivisie|2010–11 season]], two promotion/relegation playoff winners and the [[2010–11 Eerste Divisie]] champions.

==Play-offs==

===European competition===
The teams placed sixth through ninth compete in a play-off tournament for one spot in the [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League#Second qualifying round|second qualifying round]] of the [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League]]. Teams on the left played the first leg at home.

====Semi-finals====
The first legs were played on 10 May 2012, while the return legs were competed on 13 May 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=Europa League Play-offs - Semi-finals - Netherlands|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/2011-2012/final-stages/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130304040406/http://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/2011-2012/final-stages/|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 4, 2013|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=25 May 2012}}</ref>
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[N.E.C. (football club)|NEC]]|| 3–4 |'''[[Vitesse Arnhem]]'''|| 3–2 | 0–2 }}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[RKC Waalwijk]]'''|| 2–1 |[[FC Twente|Twente]]|| 1–1 | 1–0 }}
{{end}}

====Finals====
The first leg was played on 17 May 2012, while the return leg was competed on 20 May 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=Europa League Play-offs - Finals - Netherlands|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/2011-2012/final-stages/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130304040406/http://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/2011-2012/final-stages/|url-status=dead|archive-date=March 4, 2013|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=25 May 2012}}</ref>
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[RKC Waalwijk]]||2–5 |'''[[Vitesse Arnhem]]'''|| 1–3 | 1–2 }}
{{end}}

===Relegation===
[[VVV-Venlo]] and [[De Graafschap]] joined the Eerste Divisie-teams for the playoffs, after finishing 16th and 17th in the Eredivisie.
Teams on the left played the first leg at home.

====Round 1====
The first legs were played on 1 May 2012, while the return legs were competed on 5 May 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=Matches 1st Round - Play-offs 1/2 - Netherlands|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/nacompetitie/20112012/1st-round/matches/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250816054047/https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/nacompetitie/20112012/3rd-round/r17687/|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 16, 2025|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=11 May 2012}}</ref>
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Go Ahead Eagles]]|| 1–3 |'''[[FC Den Bosch|Den Bosch]]'''|| 1–1  | 0–2 }}
{{TwoLegResult|[[MVV Maastricht|MVV]]|| 1–2 |'''[[SC Cambuur|Cambuur]]'''|| 0–2 | 1–0 }}
{{end}}

====Round 2====
The first legs were played on 10 May 2012, with the return legs were competed on 13 May 2012.<ref>{{cite web|title=Matches 2nd Round - Play-offs 1/2 - Netherlands|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/nacompetitie/20112012/2nd-round/matches/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250816054047/https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/nacompetitie/20112012/3rd-round/r17687/|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 16, 2025|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=11 May 2012}}</ref>
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[FC Den Bosch|Den Bosch]]'''|| 1–1 |[[De Graafschap]]|| 0–0 | 1–1 }}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]'''|| 3–2 |[[Sparta Rotterdam]]|| 2–1 | 1–1 }}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Helmond Sport]]'''|| 3–0 |[[FC Eindhoven|Eindhoven]]|| 1–0 | 2–0 }}
{{TwoLegResult|[[SC Cambuur|Cambuur]]|| 3–4 |'''[[VVV-Venlo]]'''|| 0–0 | 3–4 }}
{{end}}
